purpose: Every place Skill 49 stops, refuses, holds or waits, told in fifth-grade words: what happened, why the rule exists, what will fix it, and 2 to 4 choices. Reason codes stay in logs; only these words reach the client.
how_to_add: A new client-facing stop ships with an entry here (scripts/test_explain_stop.py fails otherwise). {placeholders} are filled from real facts; an unfilled one falls back to defaults.

fallback.what_happened: The funnel work stopped before it finished.
fallback.why: This skill stops instead of guessing when something does not look right, so nothing wrong reaches your pages, your buyers or your bill.
fallback.fix: Find out what stopped it, fix that one thing, and run it again.
choices: I look into what stopped it, fix it, and run it again.
I explain the problem to you in more detail before I change anything.
I stop here and wait for your decision.

AF-FUN-BENEFIT-NO-CTA.what_happened: Benefit 1 or Benefit 2 has a button, and those two must not have one.
AF-FUN-BENEFIT-NO-CTA.why: The method saves the big button for Benefit 3, the peak of the story. An early button weakens it.
AF-FUN-BENEFIT-NO-CTA.fix: Take the button out of Benefit 1 and Benefit 2.
choices: I rewrite it for you so it fits, and show you before anything else runs.
You send me the change yourself and I check it right away.
I stop here and wait for your decision.

AF-FUN-BENEFIT-WORDS.what_happened: {section_label} has {count} words. It must be between {min} and {max} words.
AF-FUN-BENEFIT-WORDS.why: These lengths are part of the Signature Funnel method and they never change. Too short is as much a miss as too long.
choices: I rewrite {section_label} to fit, and show you before anything else runs.
You send me the change yourself and I check it right away.
Keep it as it is and I check it again, so you can see the exact numbers.

AF-FUN-BUILD-FAB.why: Your copy must score at least 8.5 out of 10 before the funnel is called done. Without the scorecard, that check would be skipped.
AF-FUN-BUILD-FAB.fix: Create the scorecard from your approved copy, then run the check again.

AF-FUN-BUILD-MALFORMED.fix: Run the build step again so it writes its record.
choices: I run the build step again.

FD-MODE.why: Each mode has its own steps. Running a job in the wrong mode would skip its checks.

FD-PIN-ROTATION.why: Only the owner's approved process may reseal the checking tools, so no one can quietly change the rules.
FD-PIN-ROTATION.fix: Leave the seal alone; it is updated by the approved process when a new version ships.

FD-SELF-TEST.why: The tools test themselves before they test your work. If the self-check fails, their answers cannot be trusted.
FD-SELF-TEST.fix: Update or repair the skill on this computer, then run the self-check again.

LAUNCH-ALREADY-APPROVED.what_happened: This plan is already approved, so it cannot be changed in place.
LAUNCH-ALREADY-APPROVED.why: Once you approve a plan, it is locked. A change makes a new plan that you approve again, so you always know exactly what you said yes to.
LAUNCH-ALREADY-APPROVED.fix: Ask for a revision; I then show you the changed plan to approve.
choices: I start a revision and send you the new plan.
I keep the approved plan as it is.
I stop here and wait for your decision.

LAUNCH-APPROVAL.what_happened: Your approval for this step is missing, expired, or does not match the plan.
LAUNCH-APPROVAL.why: Nothing is built, charged or published until you approve that exact plan. If the plan changed, the old yes does not count.
LAUNCH-APPROVAL.fix: Approve the current plan (reply in chat, tap the button, or use Command Center).
choices: I send you the plan to approve now.
I show you what changed since your last approval.
I stop here and wait for your decision.

LAUNCH-CARD-FIELDS.what_happened: The order form text asks for card details, which this page must never do.
LAUNCH-CARD-FIELDS.why: Card details are only taken by the real, secure checkout form, never by a designed page.
LAUNCH-CARD-FIELDS.fix: Remove the card, expiry and security code fields from the order form text.
choices: I rewrite it for you so it fits, and show you before anything else runs.
I stop here and wait for your decision.
match: names card, expiry or security-code fields

LAUNCH-DESIGN-RECORD.what_happened: A page's final mockups are not done yet, so nothing was recorded.
LAUNCH-DESIGN-RECORD.why: Final mockups are drawn only after you approve that page's design board.
LAUNCH-DESIGN-RECORD.fix: Approve the design boards that are waiting, then make the final mockups.
choices: I send you the design boards that are waiting for your approval.
I stop here and wait for your decision.
match: run this tool first, then record final-mockups

LAUNCH-IMAGE-CAP.what_happened: Your picture budget does not cover the pictures this launch needs.
LAUNCH-IMAGE-CAP.why: Pictures cost money. We stop at the budget you set, so you are never charged more than you approved.
LAUNCH-IMAGE-CAP.fix: Raise the picture budget, or make fewer pictures.
choices: I ask you to approve a bigger picture budget, with the exact amount.
I make fewer pictures to fit your budget and show you which ones.
I stop here and wait for your decision.

LAUNCH-MISSING-FACT.what_happened: Your launch plan still needs some facts before you can approve it: {missing}.
LAUNCH-MISSING-FACT.why: We never make up a price, a product, a date or a link. The plan waits until you give the real ones, so nothing false is built or charged.
LAUNCH-MISSING-FACT.fix: Give the missing facts, then I put the plan together again.
choices: I ask you only the missing questions now.
I suggest values for you to approve or change.
I stop here and wait for your decision.

LAUNCH-PAID-NEEDS-OK.what_happened: Making the real designs costs money, and your OK for that cost is missing.
LAUNCH-PAID-NEEDS-OK.why: Nothing that costs money runs until you approve the amount.
LAUNCH-PAID-NEEDS-OK.fix: Approve the picture cost, or use free placeholder designs for now.
choices: I send you the exact cost to approve.
I make free placeholders first, after you approve that.

LAUNCH-PAYMENT-PLAN.what_happened: One of your prices is set up as a payment plan or a free trial first.
LAUNCH-PAYMENT-PLAN.why: Payment plans and trials are not supported in this release, so the order form cannot charge them correctly. We stop now instead of after you approve.
LAUNCH-PAYMENT-PLAN.fix: Make that price one payment, or a repeating price (weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly).
choices: I change it to one payment for you to approve.
I change it to a monthly price for you to approve.
I stop here and wait for your decision.
match: payment plans are not supported in this release

RUN-FILE-UNREADABLE.what_happened: A work file this step needs ({file}) is missing or could not be read.
RUN-FILE-UNREADABLE.why: Every check reads the real work file. If the file is missing or broken, nothing can be checked, so we stop instead of passing it blindly.
RUN-FILE-UNREADABLE.fix: Make that file again from the step before it, then run the check again.
choices: I make the file again from the step before it and run the check again.
I show you which step made that file so we can redo it.
I stop here and wait for your decision.
